About 431-433 Broadway

PLEASE READ *Current availability* #51A- $2495- Basement level 2 bedroom. *1 free month rent* There is NO BROKER FEE to rent an apartment at this location. You would be working directly with Property Management. All apartments will be professionally cleaned and painted in between tenancy. 431-433 Broadway in Somerville is a professionally owned and managed building. Renters here enjoy free heat, and hot water. The location is good, 10 minute walk to the T at Gilman Sq. The 89 and 101 bus lines have stops right near the building. Just a couple minute drive to Rt 93. There are a range of apartments sizes and prices for studios, and 1bedroom apartments. Pricing varies based upon the size of the apartment and level of renovation Lots of local hot spots including Olde Magoun's Saloon! Laundry and indoor bike storage on site

About Ten
Hills
Ten Hills, located between Assembly Row and the Mystic River, is a residential and waterfront Somerville neighborhood with hillside streets and river-edge paths. The neighborhood’s character concentrates around the Mystic Avenue–Temple Street corridor, where small storefronts, takeout counters, and auto-oriented services meet steady river traffic. Housing leans toward early-20th-century two- and three-family homes with porches, plus a few newer mid-rise buildings near the water. The Mystic River shoreline sets a calm, open backdrop for walks and bike rides. Assembly Row adds a polished retail-and-dining district at the edge of the neighborhood. Ten Hills Park provides a compact green pause among the tight street grid.

Provided by Walk Score and Local Logic
